name: Gray Bear Tongue
summary: In Hillsbrad Foothills, gray bear tongues are raw reagents sought by the Royal Apothecary Society in Tarren Mill for experimental toxins.

sections.title: Apothecary Research in Hillsbrad
sections.body: Gray bears roam the wilds around Tarren Mill in several sturdy varieties. Their tongues hold heavy muscular tissue and fluids that Apothecary Lydon uses as a base ingredient for lethal solutions, including the Elixir of Suffering.

faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon, stationed at the Forsaken outpost of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills, seeks gray bear tongues to brew experimental killing agents.

faq.q: What is the Apothecary using these tongues for?
faq.answer: Lydon uses gray bear tongues as one of the primary organic agents in the Elixir of Suffering, a lethal concoction designed to help plague Hillsbrad’s living human populations. Creeper ichor is another ingredient.
Gray bear tongues come from local gray bears roaming the Hillsbrad Foothills, including standard gray bears, elder gray bears, vicious gray bears, and Big Samras, a notorious beast.

angles.text: As an undead, you help the Royal Apothecary Society craft new plagues against the living by procuring organic components from local wildlife.
